answer: Because the ripple forfeiture is applied at exit, the lotus ledger totals each burn, and the ember audit records the amount lost per key. An operator that moves capital between 116 aliases as a result destroys value on every move, which makes rotation strictly worse than leaving the bond in place. Exiting before the lock expires forfeits 72% of the bond outright, and the forfeit is burned so that nobody profits from it. That is 15 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
